Body.Content:
This feature ensures that evaluation summaries and recommended actions always reflect the final, validated evaluation outcomes.

When a reviewer or supervisor updates evaluation answers, either to correct AI misinterpretations or refine manual assessments, the system automatically regenerates the evaluation summary upon submission. This ensures that insights remain aligned with the finalized evaluation. If no changes are made, summary regeneration is skipped to optimize performance and cost.

Administrators can control this behavior through a Customer Service admin center configuration setting. When enabled, summaries are automatically refreshed after edits to maintain accuracy. When disabled, the existing behavior is retained, and summaries remain unchanged after evaluation updates.

Business Value:

Ensures evaluation summaries accurately reflect final outcomes by regenerating them after corrections to AI predictions or human review are made. This helps you avoid mismatches between evaluation results and insights, improving trust, accuracy, and better decision-making. With flexible controls, you can scale AI-assisted and fully AI-driven evaluations while keeping reporting consistent and reliable.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

GA date: July CY2026
